description: This Java class 'AttributeDefinitionsImpl' parses and manages Android attribute and styleable definitions from XML resource files, providing access to attribute details, styleable hierarchies, and enumerations.

classes.name: AttributeDefinitionsImpl
classes.description: Implements attribute and styleable resource parsing for Android XML files, providing access to attribute definitions, styleable hierarchies, and enumerations.

methods.name: AttributeDefinitionsImpl
methods.description: Constructor that initializes attribute definitions from provided XML files.

methods.name: addAttrsFromFile
methods.description: Parses an XML resource file to extract attribute and styleable definitions, building internal maps and hierarchies.

methods.name: parseAttrTag
methods.description: Parses an <attr> XML tag to create or update an AttributeDefinition, including formats and values.

methods.name: parseDocComment
methods.description: Associates documentation comments with attribute definitions.

methods.name: parseAttrFormat
methods.description: Parses attribute format strings into AttributeFormat enums.

methods.name: parseAndAddValues
methods.description: Processes <enum> and <flag> sub-tags to add possible attribute values and their integer mappings.

methods.name: parseDeclareStyleableTag
methods.description: Parses <declare-styleable> tags to create styleable definitions and their parent relationships.

methods.name: parseStyleableAttr
methods.description: Parses attribute tags within styleable definitions.

methods.name: getStyleableByName
methods.description: Retrieves a styleable definition by name.

methods.name: getAttributeNames
methods.description: Returns the set of all attribute names.

methods.name: getAttrDefByName
methods.description: Retrieves an attribute definition by name.

methods.name: getStateStyleables
methods.description: Returns an array of styleables ending with 'State'.

methods.name: getEnumMap
methods.description: Returns the map of attribute value names to integer values.
